about: GAMMA-Ray Spectrum cards as gamma-ray.sgit.ai publishes them (beta; every rating experimental), read by newsroom/tools/gamma-pull.mjs. Levels: A autonomy, R reach, C control, O openness, 1 to 4, 0 where not yet evidenced. The source of every card is its page on gamma-ray.sgit.ai.

cards.name: RiskMandate Publisher
cards.what: The agent that reads RiskMandate's private stories vault and writes the public site riskmandate.ai.

cards.name: The PrompTugal.news agent team
cards.what: The team of Claude Code sessions that builds and runs promptugal.news: a conductor, a journalist, a developer and others, each with its own key, policy and folder.

cards.name: AI Grant Consultant
cards.what: Chat-based agent, onboarded with the organisation's details and past applications, that matches funding calls, checks eligibility and admissibility, drafts applications section by section with playbooks, scores drafts with an Evaluator, and supports post-approval reporting. cards.what: Opt-in pull request reviewer on GitHub that combines Codacy's static analysis with a language model, reads the PR, linked Jira or Linear tickets and repository instructions, and posts a review with a verdict, a summary, test suggestions and inline comments with suggested fixes. cards.name: AISLE platform
cards.what: AISLE's platform of AI agents that finds vulnerabilities in source code, triages them, writes and tests patches, and delivers them as pull requests for people to merge.

cards.name: Automaise Conversational AI
cards.what: Voice and chat assistant (inbound and outbound voice, customer self-service chat, internal helpdesk chat) that answers customers and completes transactions such as data changes, payments and orders.

cards.name: ByTheLaw
cards.what: Chat assistant that answers legal questions with citations to official Portuguese and EU sources, analyses uploaded documents, drafts contracts, emails and translations, and organises work in projects. The site menu names it 'ByTheLaw: Legal research and knowledge'; the help centre calls it 'Legal C

cards.name: Claude Code on the web
cards.what: The same coding agent in a cloud session: a managed container with one repository attached and a proxy above it.

cards.name: Claude Code, on your own machine
cards.what: The command-line coding agent, running as the user’s own account on their machine, with the settings it ships with.

cards.name: GetVocal AI agents
cards.what: GetVocal AI's voice, chat, WhatsApp and email agents for enterprise contact centres, built in its Agent Builder and supervised by people through its control console.

cards.name: GitHub Copilot cloud agent
cards.what: The asynchronous agent on GitHub.com that creates branches, writes code and opens pull requests in response to assigned issues.

cards.name: Hackian
cards.what: AI agent that runs reconnaissance, exploits vulnerabilities with non-destructive routines and reports findings with proof of exploitation; used in Continuous Adversarial Exposure Validation and in Agentic Pentests (Swift, Depth).

cards.name: Junie
cards.what: JetBrains' coding agent that plans and makes changes in a code base, in JetBrains IDEs, on the command line and in CI through GitHub and GitLab.

cards.name: LEGALFLY agents
cards.what: Platform of legal agents (Discovery, Review, Draft, Multi Review, Legal Radar, Translation) plus Agent Studio, where customers build multi-step workflows with triggers, conditions, approvals and notifications.

cards.name: Manus
cards.what: Manus AI's general agent that plans and carries out tasks for a user in a cloud sandbox, and also through a desktop app, a browser extension and an API.

cards.name: Noxus AI Workers
cards.what: Configurable agents that use flows, integration actions, knowledge bases, tables, MCP servers, code execution and a sandbox to carry out tasks, deployed through the web app, API, SDK, chat widget, Slack, Teams, Google Chat, WhatsApp or Telegram.

cards.name: OutSystems Agent Workbench
cards.what: Builds, runs and governs AI agents (agentic apps) on OutSystems Developer Cloud (ODC): agents call server actions, MCP tools and external A2A agents, with guardrails, evaluations, traces and workflow human-in-the-loop steps.

cards.name: Pebl Alfie
cards.what: An AI assistant embedded in Pebl's employer-of-record platform that answers global employment questions, builds workforce reports from the customer's Pebl data, and submits or approves time-off requests for the user who asks.

cards.name: Replit Agent
cards.what: Replit's AI agent that builds, runs, tests and publishes software from a description in plain language, inside a Replit project.

cards.name: Spinnable AI employees
cards.what: Role-based AI workers with their own email address, memory, scheduled tasks and access to 35+ connected tools, reachable by email, WhatsApp, Slack, meetings and voice.

cards.name: SPN AI job scanner
cards.what: Python scrapers collect roles from UK real estate firms' careers pages into a database; a large language model decides whether each role is accepted onto the list, and accepted roles appear in the app and site.

cards.name: Talkdesk Autopilot
cards.what: Customer-facing AI agent that resolves requests and completes tasks across voice, digital and email channels, handing over to a human agent when needed.

cards.name: Visor.ai AI agents
cards.what: Visor.ai's voice and chat AI agents for customer service, with Nexa, the agent that builds, tests and proposes fixes to them.
